description: Named boundary profiles reference which path and action checks apply. Slices may declare a profile id in governance text until schema adds a formal field.

profiles.label: Default RedDirt self-build
profiles.notes: Cross-lane, secret, send, and migration patterns enforced on allowedWrites; global patterns also checked on allowedPaths.

profiles.label: Docs and data/selfbuild only
profiles.notes: Still denies sibling and sos-public paths; does not relax prisma or send rules on allowedWrites.

profiles.label: Approved Prisma migration slice
profiles.notes: Only meaningful when sliceType is database_migration and humanApprovalGates are filled; migration phrases allowed on writes only inside prisma paths.
